JEE Main — Mock CBT (Test 3, Physics)

This is a self-paced NTA-style computer based test built from your uploaded question set. (Note: one duplicate question in the source folder was removed, so this test has 20 unique questions instead of 21.)

  • 20 Questions, 75 minutes. A countdown timer runs top-right; the test auto-submits at zero.
  • Each question also tracks the time you spend on it individually — shown live and in your final report.
  • Two question types: MCQ (choose 1/2/3/4) and Numerical Value (type the number).
  • Marking: +4 correct, −1 incorrect, 0 unattempted (standard JEE Main scheme) for both types.
  • Use Save & Next, Mark for Review & Next, or Clear Response. The question palette on the right shows status of every question — click any number to jump to it.
  • Click Submit Test any time to end early and see your score, time analysis, and full solutions.
